name: Summary / Totals Section
description: The right-aligned totals block that closes a document entry page. An empty xs:8 spacer pushes an xs:4 column to the right edge; every row is a standard field wrapper holding a dxnumlbl. Values come from a single stored formula (molecule.stored-action-formula) invoked from every mutation path, NOT from per-control bindings.
sourceRefs: examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md PART 6 (Total Quantity, Gross Amount, Discount(%), Additional Amount, VAT Amount, Net Amount)

rows.description: List of { labelText, field } — one dxnumlbl row each.

editablePercentRowTemplate.description: A totals row where the user enters a percentage and the resulting amount displays beside it — two controls in one entryValueDiv via display:flex. whenchange (not onFocusOut) because the maths is purely local.

rules: Every value here is a dxnumlbl, never a disabled dxnumberbox — these are always-computed values (see atoms/numeric-label.json for the distinction).
Rows that can be switched off by doctype configuration go inside a hide wrapper at field-pair granularity, e.g. HIDE_VAT around the VAT Amount row.

Totals are produced by ONE stored formula defined in whenload and invoked as "[calcformula]" from every mutation path — row edits, row deletes, header discount changes. Never bind a total to an inline aggregate expression on the control itself.
The formula must be split into sequenced merges when later values depend on earlier ones (raw aggregates first, then derived totals). See molecule.stored-action-formula.
